_comment: Street-level coverage for the sales map (D-118). Each box encloses the named county and every county touching it (Chris, 2026-10-27). Boxes are deliberately a little generous: a box is cheap, a missing road isn't. Edit here and re-run ops/maps/refresh-basemap.sh to change coverage.

properties.name: Charlotte
properties.counties: Mecklenburg NC + Cabarrus, Union, Gaston, Lincoln, Iredell (NC); York, Lancaster (SC)

properties.name: Triad (Greensboro / Winston-Salem)
properties.counties: Guilford + Forsyth, and every county touching either: Rockingham, Caswell, Alamance, Chatham, Randolph, Davidson, Stokes, Davie, Yadkin, Surry

properties.name: Raleigh
properties.counties: Wake + Durham, Granville, Franklin, Nash, Johnston, Harnett, Chatham

properties.name: South Florida
properties.counties: Broward + Palm Beach, Miami-Dade, Collier, Hendry
